title: qos_contention.dem header claims pipe 0 is oversubscribed ~2.4x; the actual sim shows ~4x (60 units/tick offered vs 15 capacity; 334 of 460 spawned dropped)
evidence: demos/qos_contention.dem:2-3: "# contention drop ladder (E7/E9). Pipe 0 (res 0 -> router 1) is oversubscribed" / "# ~2.4x with two classes the PLAYER categorized (canon 2026-08-12 — nothing". data/balance.json: "\"packet_bandwidth\": 30," and "\"logic_hz\": 20,". data/pipe_tiers.json (standard tier): "      \"capacity_units\": 15,". Spawn cadence in the demo: "at 500ms spawn 0 2 email" / "at 525ms spawn 2 0 streaming" — alternating every 25ms, i.e. 1 packet per direction per tick (logic_hz 20) = 2 arrivals/tick × 30 units = 60 units/tick offered on pipe 0 vs 15 capacity = 4.0x. Instrumented run of these exact sources at ffc9b7b: "DBG qos_contention: arrived=112 drops=334 (email=186 stream=148, qov=334 pool=0)" — 334 of 460 spawns (230 email + 230 streaming, verified by grep -c) dropped = 72.6% drop rate, consistent with ~4x (a 2.4x pipe would drop ~58%).
detail: The ~2.4x figure is not derivable from any definition of the actual sim (offered/capacity = 4.0x; per-lane 3x-6x; measured drop rate 72.6%). The demo mechanics (BE-first drops on pipe 0, queue pile, lane-order exit) are unaffected — only the documented figure is wrong.
recommended_fix: Correct the demo header (and any PR copy quoting it) to ~4x — or quote the measured ratio (60 units/tick offered vs 15 capacity on pipe 0).
